description_en: Polls the agent status of a specified agent under a specified instance. This operation is typically invoked by the frontend agent Workbench to synchronize agent status
description_zh: 轮询指定实例下指定坐席的坐席状态，一般由前端坐席工作台调用，用于同步坐席状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc poll-user-status --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PollUserStatus

parameters.help_en: The Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id
